source_findings.weakness: Cyber security risk updates were not current when reported to oversight committees, averaging 31 days old.
source_findings.evidence_quote: Where there were documented updates, they were completed an average of 31 days prior to the oversight committee meeting

source_findings.weakness: The Census Program Board did not receive updates on PR3 while it was outside risk tolerance for most of the period, limiting monitoring of the risk.
source_findings.evidence_quote: This did not support effective monitoring of this key risk by the CPB.

source_findings.weakness: Some systems submitted for security assessment had limited high-level architecture documentation, restricting assessment of security design.
source_findings.evidence_quote: some systems presented for security assessment contained limited architectural detail, relying on security context documents rather than full architecture documentation

source_findings.weakness: Scheduled review workshops to assess quality gate relevance and effectiveness were not held, and the reason was not documented.
source_findings.evidence_quote: These workshops were not held and the rationale was not documented.

source_findings.weakness: One post gate activity lacked the required sign-off confirming completion.
source_findings.evidence_quote: one gate was missing the required sign off to confirm a PGA had been completed

source_findings.weakness: Three post gate activities lacked evidence supporting their completion.
source_findings.evidence_quote: three gates were missing evidence supporting the activity’s completion

source_findings.weakness: Three post gate activities were completed after their due dates.
source_findings.evidence_quote: three gates had activities that were completed after the due date

source_findings.weakness: Holistic cyber security planning for the 2026 Census did not address risks across the entirety of the ABS ICT environment.
source_findings.evidence_quote: it did not address risks across the entirety of the ABS ICT environment.

source_findings.weakness: The ABS did not implement all key cyber security mitigation controls.
source_findings.evidence_quote: however, did not implement all key mitigation controls.

source_findings.weakness: IRAP assessments were incompletely scheduled and assessments that should have been completed had not commenced.
source_findings.evidence_quote: IRAP assessments that should have been completed had not yet commenced

source_findings.weakness: Gaps in information and documentation delayed assurance activities.
source_findings.evidence_quote: gaps in information and documentation were delaying some assurance activities

source_findings.weakness: Deadlines for addressing cyber security components of the Essential Eight mitigation strategies were repeatedly missed.
source_findings.evidence_quote: has repeatedly missed deadlines for achievement
